# simplemdm_dep_device (Data Source)

Retrieves a single DEP device under a DEP server by its DEP device ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "simplemdm_dep_device" "specific" {
  dep_server_id = "1"
  id            = "42"
}

output "model" {
  value = data.simplemdm_dep_device.specific.model
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `dep_server_id` (String) Required. The DEP server ID this device belongs to.
- `id` (String) Required. DEP device ID.

### Read-Only

- `color` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `device_assigned_by` (String)
- `device_assigned_date` (String)
- `device_family` (String)
- `model` (String)
- `os` (String)
- `profile_assign_time` (String)
- `profile_push_time` (String)
- `profile_status` (String)
- `serial_number` (String)
